PullRequest.Title: copilot: remove unused function body outline helper
PullRequest.Body:
Refs https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-internalbacklog/issues/9678

Remove the unused removeBodiesOutsideRange helper and its exclusive TreeSitterOffsetRange import. Keep the live selection-context and notebook-context generation code unchanged.

Scenarios.Scenario: Inline chat context generation and resolver loading
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The deleted function has no callers, so live selection and notebook prompt generation remain unchanged; module loading only has less dead code.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Up to the existing 100 context steps per prompt; unchanged by the diff.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One synchronous in-memory context pass per prompt; unchanged.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No changed cache or coalescing behavior.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the complete diff only deletes an unreferenced helper and type-only import, and repository search found no callers.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Any code-size improvement is small and unmeasured.
Scenarios.Verdict: No performance regression or evidenced regression fix.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
